Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, configurable glam locks, local Synced Looks and Customize+ profile/template choices. Shared Customize+ profiles require separate consent. Automatic styling pauses safely during transfers; helmet controls never edit weapons. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Update both players to 0.6.2 for CC-transition fixes.
Changelog: Fixes GPact presence, session-control polling and Offline-lock renewal stopping when CC/duty transitions temporarily remove the local actor. Uses validated login identity for networking and retains the last public world across temporary internal duty-world values. Actual world changes, logout, character changes and expired leases still release the Offline lock; it never silently relocks. Roleplay control processing no longer waits on Glamourer outfit recovery, while actor availability and native competitive-PvP safety checks remain required. Updates the reviewed FFXIVClientStructs pin to 7.56.2.9237; GPact-used source layouts and signatures are unchanged, but in-game validation remains separate. Client-only update: no SeitonSense changes, Worker deployment or database migration. Update both players to benefit from the transition fixes.
